text:
This study will take about 20 minutes. Please read the instructions carefully.

Please also turn off any music you are playing and minimize outside distractions (distractions are known to have effects on this kind of studies and it will make our data unusable).

In this study, you will view rotating point-cloud objects and choose the best matching object category. You should click the button that best describes the object. In each trial, the number of points varies. So it is normal that you find it difficult to recognize the object in some trials. If you are unsure about the object categories, please randomly select an answer.

Here is an example of a rotating point-cloud object. You will see a practice trial next.

feedback: The correct answer is "Plant". Click "Continue" to move on to the next page.
